title: Terminology: brane vs Yekutieli
html:
Remark. Terminology: brane vs Yekutieli

The mathematics here traces the iterated jet prolongation A_{n+1} = J^1(A_n). We assign the term brane to each localized layer A_n, representing a geometric boundary enclosing level-n internal degrees of freedom.

We call the lifting condition [yekutieli2010] that governs extensions from n to n+1 the quantum lifting condition, and reserve the qualifier Yekutieli for the nonabelian multiplicative integration [yekutieli2015] over the tower. These results control structural assembly rather than the Kähler-differential jet object itself. We therefore write simply (recursive) brane tower for the sequence.
